properties.title: 35357 Colle S. Andrea
properties.summary: Certain Secondary Road (Basalt-paved road near Colle S. Andrea, in the present-day municipality of Colonna. Several traces of the paving were found between 2006 and 2024. The pavement, consisting of large polygonal basalt blocks laid with extreme care, shows evident ruts caused by the repeated passage of carts. Considering the topographical context, the dimensions of the roadway, and its considerable state of wear, it is possible to hypothesize that the road route could be the Via Labicana. Alternatively, although less likely, it might be an alternative route to the same consular road.)

Considering the topographical context, the dimensions of the roadway, and its considerable state of wear, it is possible to hypothesize that the road route could be the Via Labicana. Alternatively, although less likely, it might be an alternative route to the same consular road.)
